questions: Does s-bend progress stay at or above 0.15 with the 8 mm footprint at 1 cm pitch?
Does line_loss_events fall below 1 per run, or stay at 1?
Is steering_oscillation still within 0.07 to 0.16, or does the narrower footprint make the signal noisier at the tape edges?
Are there any readings that fall to zero across the array (sum below 0.05) on the bends, which would point to gaps between footprints?
Is rms_error still near 0.03 on all tracks? If so, the offset is probably a motor-mismatch term, and the lever is the controller.
feedback_request.requested_changes_if_any: If s-bend progress falls below 0.11 or the oval falls below 0.11, restore sensor_size 0.012 m. If the result is unchanged and line losses stay at 1, tell me whether the line_loss setting (last_direction versus search) is the next lever, since geometry will then have reached its plateau.

intent: Single-variable test from iteration 7: keep the seven-sensor, 1 cm pitch, 4 cm lead layout and change only sensor_size from 0.012 to 0.008 m. This tests whether a narrower footprint sharpens the edge signal and reduces the one line loss per run. Expect s-bend progress at or above 0.15, oval at or above 0.11, and line_loss_events at or below 1 per run, with the score near 51. The Integrator should use weights x/0.015 (-2, -1.333, -0.667, 0, 0.667, 1.333, 2), the same slope as iterations 6 and 7.
learning: Iteration 7 (12 mm, 1 cm pitch) scored 51.1159, matching iteration 6 (16 mm) at 51.1083, so footprint is neutral at 1 cm pitch. Pitch 1 cm or 1.5 cm is safe, and pitch of 2 cm or wider collapses s-bend progress to 0.04. Lead of 4 cm is the only lead tested that works (2 cm and 3 cm collapse). Across all geometries, one line loss per run and max_error of about 0.06 m persist, which suggests the remaining limit is the controller or the line_loss handling. Measure the 8 mm result on all three tracks to confirm footprint is exhausted before recommending a controller change.
rationale: Iteration 7 tested footprint at 1 cm pitch: seven 12 mm sensors at x = -0.03 to +0.03, y = 0.04 m. It scored 51.1159, against 51.1083 for the 16 mm footprint in iteration 6. Per-track results were unchanged: s-bend progress 0.155, oval 0.11, slalom 0.1075, one line loss per run and max_error about 0.061 to 0.067 m. Footprint is therefore neutral at 1 cm pitch, as it was at 1.5 cm pitch in iterations 1 and 4. The pitch collapse (2 cm or wider) and the lead collapse (below 4 cm) are both established, and no geometry tested so far has removed the one line loss per run or the off-track exit at about 0.06 m. The Geometry Realm's own decision rule for this case is met: s-bend progress is at least 0.15 and line losses are at most 1, so the next geometry test is a narrower footprint. I therefore propose sensor_size 0.008 m with the same seven-sensor, 1 cm pitch, 4 cm lead layout. The only change is the footprint, which tests whether the 12 mm footprint over-weights the outer sensors. A 8 mm footprint at 10 mm pitch still covers the 25 mm tape (about 4 mm gap between footprints). Body, mass, track and wheel radius stay fixed. Expected result: s-bend progress stays at or above 0.15 and line losses stay at or below 1, with the score close to 51. If progress falls below 0.11 on the oval or s-bend, the footprint was needed and I restore 0.012 m. If the result is unchanged, geometry has reached its plateau and the remaining lever is the controller (line_loss setting or gains), which I will say so in the next feedback request. Iterations 1 and 7 differ by only 0.15 points, so I do not treat the 0.272 best score in iteration 1 as a meaningful improvement.
